summary: Sakakihara pushed Union City to consider a Gaza ceasefire resolution in 2024, though the record does not establish a final council vote. In a questionnaire he opposes delegitimizing Israel and campaigns isolating Jewish communities while supporting dialogue and peace. CAIR Action listed him as preferred rather than endorsed for the general election; the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose mission includes supporting Israel, endorsed him. He is open to reviewing AB 715 to address concerns of supporters and opponents.
